podcast.title: Choice of Lead Singles for Fleetwood Mac (1975)
podcast.body: Reprise Records, an imprint of Warner Brothers, was responsible for choosing the lead singles for Fleetwood Mac's 1975 self-titled album. They selected Christine McVie's "Warm Ways" for England and "Over My Head" for America, demonstrating their faith in McVie's songwriting to reintroduce the band. "When it came time to choose a lead single for the Fleetwood Mack album, the band and their label, the Warner Brothers imprint reprise, went with Christine McVeigh's songs on both sides of the Atlantic."

podcast.title: Concept Album Strategy
podcast.body: Reprise Records released two major alt rock concept albums, Green Day's *American Idiot* and My Chemical Romance's *The Black Parade*, within a few years of each other, suggesting a potential label strategy to capitalize on the success of the format. "And like Green Day, my chemical romance was on the reprise label."

podcast.title: Founded by Frank Sinatra
podcast.body: Reprise Records was established in 1960 by Frank Sinatra, who at that time was recognized as the biggest star of the 20th century. Green Day later signed a record deal with this label. "reprise records, the label created by of all people Frank Sinatra in 1960, who was the biggest star of the 20th century to that point."

podcast.title: Grimbey Signing
podcast.body: Grimbey ultimately signed with Reprise Records after considering numerous offers from major labels. Although not the largest multinational, Reprise was a significant record company and part of Warner Brothers, making the signing a notable step for the band from their underground roots. "firmaron por repris y récordos, no era una grandísima multinacional, pero era una escográfica bastante importante y a la vez pertenecía Warner Brothers."

podcast.title: Producer Rob Cavallo's Influence
podcast.body: Rob Cavallo, a key figure at Reprise Records, played a crucial role as a co-producer of Grimbey's album "Dookie." His involvement was instrumental in the album's success, marking the first time the band worked with an external professional producer. "Rob Cavallo era una persona muy importante del repris y records que fue la discográfica que hizo este álbum y que realmente es una de las personas que ha ido mucho al éxito de este disco."
